hero.description: Quassama helps friends, families, and teams track shared expenses, split costs fairly, and stay organized — all in one simple app.

imageScannerFeature.description: No more manual entry. Just take a photo of your receipt or facture, and let Quassama's AI instantly extract the amount, date, and category. Effortless expense logging in seconds.

leftCard.title: Group Expenses Are Always Messy
leftCard.description: Managing shared expenses often leads to confusion, forgotten payments, and unfair splits. Quassama removes friction by organizing every expense clearly and transparently.

rightCard.title: One App. Total Clarity.
rightCard.description: Quassama centralizes all group expenses, automatically calculates balances, and shows who owes what in real time — so everyone stays on the same page.

item2.title: Daily Smart Reminders
item2.description: Get a personalized daily saving target so you never fall behind your goal — small steps, big results.

item3.title: Track Multiple Goals
item3.description: Run several saving challenges at once — for a trip, a gadget, or an emergency fund — all in one place.

groupExpense.title: Group Expense Management
groupExpense.description: Instantly split bills 50/50 or by percentage without the math headache. Everyone stays on the same page.

voiceDetection.title: Smart Expense Detection

organization.title: Smart Expense Organization

budget.title: Monthly Budget Control

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about Quassama.

q1.question: Is Quassama free to use?
q1.answer: Yes! The core features, including expense tracking, receipt scanning, and basic voice logging, are completely free. We offer a 'Pro' subscription for power users who want unlimited entries, cloud sync, and advanced export features.

q2.question: How accurate is the Voice Detection & Receipt Scanning?
q2.answer: Our voice AI is trained specifically for Moroccan dialects (Darija), French, and English. Our receipt scanner intelligently parses amounts, dates, and text from images instantly, making manual entry a thing of the past.

q3.question: Is my financial data safe?
q3.answer: Absolutely. We use bank-level encryption for all data. Your expenses are private to you (and the specific friends you choose to share them with). We never sell your data.

q4.question: Can I use it offline?
q4.answer: Yes, you can track expenses offline. The app will automatically sync your data to the cloud the next time you connect to the internet.
